themes.evidence: designing, developing, and deploying AI agents to automate software development workflows and processes
leverage Large Language Models and agentic AI to automate end to end software engineering workflows
Continuously measure and report on the impact of AI interventions, demonstrating improvements in key metrics like cycle time, change failure rate
Create and deploy predictive models to identify high-risk commits, forecast potential build failures
Experience with tools for CI/CD setup such as Jenkins, Gitlab CI, Packer, Terraform, Artifactory, Ansible, Chef or similar
Ability to effectively work across organizational boundaries

archetype_rationale: The core mandate is building and shipping LLM/agentic tools that automate engineering workflows ('design and implement tools and software solutions that leverage Large Language Models and agentic AI'), with hands-on agent deployment listed in the day-to-day responsibilities. Full-stack and CI/CD skills are supporting requirements for delivering those agent tools internally, not the job's center of gravity.
notes: JD asks for 10+ years experience and deep full-stack breadth (React/Angular, Django/Rails/Spring, Terraform/Ansible) — resume tailoring should foreground production engineering depth and measurable developer-productivity impact (cycle time, MTTR-style metrics), not just agent demos. RAG and LLM fine-tuning appear only in 'Ways To Stand Out', so treat as differentiators, not core requirements.
